description: Shared KyTiXo preset: 3-day release age gate, immediate security fixes, automerge only devDependencies and GitHub Actions after CI passes.

packageRules.description: Skip the age gate for update types without release timestamps (mirrors security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm, for all datasources); otherwise they stay pending forever.
Automerge non-major devDependencies once CI passes.
One automerged PR for all GitHub Actions updates, majors included.
